1.w: For the music director, according to the sheminith style; a psalm of David. Deliver, Lord! For the godly have disappeared; people of integrity have vanished.

2.w: People lie to one another; they flatter and deceive.

3.w: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts!

4.w: They say, “We speak persuasively; we know how to flatter and boast. Who is our master?”

5.w: “Because of the violence done to the oppressed, because of the painful cries of the needy, I will spring into action,” says the Lord. “I will provide the safety they so desperately desire.”

6.w: The Lord’s words are absolutely reliable. They are as untainted as silver purified in a furnace on the ground, where it is thoroughly refined.

7.w: You, Lord, will protect the oppressed; you will continually shelter each one from these evil people,

8.w: for the wicked seem to be everywhere, when people promote evil.
